core.title: Warwick Double Dummy Cylinder Lockset, Acorn WTLBD

text.description_html:
Acorn WTLBD, Warwick Double Dummy Cylinder Handleset

The mounts and the deadbolt rose of the Warwick Double Dummy Cylinder Locket feature an old world design that will grant a feeling of antiquity to any door--making it perfect for restoration projects. This lockset has a 10-3/4" grip and a blank cylinder plate for both the interior and the exterior of the door but since it is a dummy handleset, it neither latches nor locks. Handlesets like these are most often used as a pull on the inactive side of double doors to match the existing trim. The rough black iron finish of the Warwick Handleset duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron; and it is backed by a lifetime no rust warranty.

Dummy Handleset: Trim for non-working doors. It does not latch and does not lock. Usually used as matching trim for the non-working side of double doors.

Also Available Matching:
Warwick Single Cylinder Mortise Locket
Warwick Double Cylinder Mortise Lockset

Features of the Warwick Double Dummy Cylinder Lockset:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Package Includes: Interior and exterior handle, exterior and interior dummy cylinder, and all necessary mounting hardware.
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty

Specification for the Acorn WTKLD Warwick Black Iron Handleset:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Exterior and Interior Blank Cylinder Rose Length: 2-7/8"
  • Exterior and Interior Blank Cylinder Rose Width: 2-1/8"
  • Exterior and Interior Handle Length: 10-3/4"
  • Exterior and Interior Handle Width: 2-3/4"

Sold Individually
